title: How to Build a Referral Program With AI (The Dropbox Model, No Code Required)
summary: Build a referral program app with AI — tracking links, reward management, and analytics included. No $199/mo SaaS required. Database and hosting included.
body_markdown: The most common patterns: self-referrals using different email addresses, fake account signups to harvest rewards, and coordinated abuse from the same IP range or email domain. Build in: reject referrals where the new user's IP matches the referrer's IP, add a 24-48 hour minimum between referral and reward eligibility, and flag clusters of referrals from the same email domain for manual review. You can implement all of these as custom rules in your Blink app — something fixed-rule SaaS tools don't let you do.
